GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Worked fwd 3 Wide until raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early . Stayed 2nd Two Wide midrace & held together Four Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pushed to quicken @ 400m & challenged leader @ 300m. Pressured & hit lead @ 200m. Tried hard but over-run last 50m. # On-pace/tried hard.
Bit Slow Out Hard Ridden hence Went Forward 3 Wide of 4 to be in Lead on rail 2 Lengths Clear x 700m, Hard Ridden 300 challenged x 200m, dueled kept on tough to 50m, # solid Effort

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out at the start and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 1.5L off, saved ground turn, clear rail runs Straightening Up 1 length off, took over approaching 200m, half clear 100m, 1 length clear 100m and kept gong strong to the line # had run/too good
